paragraphs.body: Miami Heat coach Anthony Carter is recorded as the head coach on September 28, 2026. The team is currently in a winless start, prompting internal reflections from head coach Erik Spoelstra, who admitted he needs to do 'a better job' amid the disappointing 2-5 record. Center Bam Adebayo stated that critics are making him the scapegoat for the team's struggles, while Giannis Antetokounmpo acknowledged that despite his confidence in turning things around, the Heat 'got a lot of things to figure out.'

headline: Miami Heat face internal scrutiny as Spoelstra admits need for improvement amid winless start.
